### Before you start
- Read the [Contributing guide](https://biomass-disc.info/docs/contributing/).
- Make sure you can build and run the test suite locally — see the [Getting started](https://biomass-disc.info/docs/getting-started/) page.
- Every commit must be signed off (`git commit -s`) to satisfy the Developer Certificate of Origin.

### If you have questions
Comment on this issue or open a draft pull request early. The maintainers prefer
early feedback over a polished pull request that has gone in the wrong direction.
